opportunities.title: Small Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring UK and Japan together across arts and culture, humanities, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport. Grants typically range £1,500‑£5,000, exceptionally up to £6,000.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, total up to £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration is also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health‑related fields who intend to establish working links between organisations or produce a publishable comparative study. Preference for those not previously involved in UK‑Japan collaboration and early‑career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK. Grants up to £10,000 per year (maximum £30,000) for projects lasting up to three years.
